description: Shared dependency-update policy. Put this file at renovate/default.json in the repository that owns the shared gates; every repository extends it from renovate.json. Edit timezone and schedule for your team. Stack-specific rules (groups, ignored majors) go in the stack references.

packageRules.description: Security updates are raised at once, without waiting for the release-age delay.
Major updates wait for approval on the dependency dashboard.
One pull request for all GitHub Actions updates; digests stay pinned.
Docker base images are pinned to digests.
